title: General Online Meeting Conversation with Boss
theme: General office conversation during an online meeting with technical issues

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Good morning. Can you hear me clearly?
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat pagi. Apakah kamu bisa mendengar saya dengan jelas?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Good morning. Yes, I can hear you clearly. Can you hear me as well?
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat pagi. Ya, saya bisa mendengar Anda dengan jelas. Apakah Anda juga bisa mendengar saya?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Yes, I can hear you. Thank you for joining on time.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, saya bisa mendengar kamu. Terima kasih sudah bergabung tepat waktu.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Of course. I am ready to go through today’s discussion.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu. Saya siap untuk membahas diskusi hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Before we begin, how has your morning been so far?
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum kita mulai, bagaimana pagi kamu sejauh ini?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: It has been productive, although I had to finish a few urgent tasks before this meeting.
dialogue.indonesian: Cukup produktif, meskipun saya harus menyelesaikan beberapa tugas mendesak sebelum rapat ini.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That is understandable. Let us keep this meeting focused and practical.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu bisa dimengerti. Mari kita buat rapat ini tetap fokus dan praktis.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: That sounds good to me. I have my notes ready.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu terdengar baik bagi saya. Catatan saya sudah siap.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: All right. First, I would like a quick update on your current priorities.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Pertama, saya ingin pembaruan singkat tentang prioritas kamu saat ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: My current priorities are following up on pending tasks, organizing today’s action items, and preparing a summary for the team.
dialogue.indonesian: Prioritas saya saat ini adalah menindaklanjuti tugas yang tertunda, mengatur action item hari ini, dan menyiapkan ringkasan untuk tim.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Good. Are there any issues that might affect your timeline today?
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Apakah ada masalah yang mungkin memengaruhi jadwal kamu hari ini?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Actually, yes. My laptop has been freezing this morning, so it has slowed me down a little.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebenarnya, ya. Laptop saya sempat freeze pagi ini, jadi pekerjaan saya sedikit melambat.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: I see. Is it stable now, or are you still having problems?
dialogue.indonesian: Saya mengerti. Apakah sekarang sudah stabil, atau kamu masih mengalami masalah?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: It is better now, but it is still not fully stable. I am hoping it will not interrupt the meeting.
dialogue.indonesian: Sekarang lebih baik, tetapi masih belum sepenuhnya stabil. Saya berharap itu tidak mengganggu rapat.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: All right. If needed, we can pause for a moment while you recover.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Jika perlu, kita bisa berhenti sejenak sementara kamu memulihkannya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Thank you. I appreciate the flexibility.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Saya menghargai fleksibilitasnya.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Let us continue. Have you completed the items we discussed yesterday?
dialogue.indonesian: Mari kita lanjutkan. Apakah kamu sudah menyelesaikan hal-hal yang kita bahas kemarin?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Yes, most of them are done. I only need to finalize a few small details this afternoon.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, sebagian besar sudah selesai. Saya hanya perlu menyelesaikan beberapa detail kecil sore ini.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That sounds fine. Please make sure the final details do not remain open for too long.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu terdengar baik. Tolong pastikan detail terakhir itu tidak terlalu lama tertunda.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Understood. I plan to close them before the end of the day.
dialogue.indonesian: Dipahami. Saya berencana menutup semuanya sebelum akhir hari.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Can you also give me a short overview of anything that still needs coordination?
dialogue.indonesian: Bisakah kamu juga memberi saya gambaran singkat tentang hal-hal yang masih perlu koordinasi?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: There are a few items that depend on input from others, but nothing that looks critical yet.
dialogue.indonesian: Ada beberapa hal yang bergantung pada masukan dari orang lain, tetapi belum ada yang terlihat kritis.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Sorry, your audio just cut out for a moment. Could you repeat that?
dialogue.indonesian: Maaf, suara kamu tadi sempat terputus. Bisa kamu ulangi?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Of course. I said a few items still depend on input from others, but none of them are urgent yet.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu. Saya mengatakan bahwa beberapa hal masih bergantung pada masukan dari orang lain, tetapi belum ada yang mendesak.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Got it. Thank you for repeating that.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Terima kasih sudah mengulanginya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: No problem. I noticed the connection is not perfect today.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak masalah. Saya juga menyadari koneksinya tidak terlalu baik hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Yes, and now your voice sounds a little robotic. Is your internet unstable?
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, dan sekarang suara kamu terdengar agak robotik. Apakah internet kamu tidak stabil?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: It might be. Let me adjust my connection for a second.
dialogue.indonesian: Mungkin iya. Biar saya menyesuaikan koneksi saya sebentar.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Sure, take your time. We can wait.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu, santai saja. Kami bisa menunggu.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Thank you. Is my voice clearer now?
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apakah suara saya lebih jelas sekarang?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Yes, much better now. Let us continue while the connection is stable.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, jauh lebih baik sekarang. Mari kita lanjutkan selagi koneksinya stabil.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Sounds good. Where would you like me to continue from?
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Dari bagian mana Anda ingin saya lanjutkan?

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Please continue with your update on today’s coordination and meetings.
dialogue.indonesian: Tolong lanjutkan dengan pembaruan kamu tentang koordinasi dan rapat hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I have two follow-up discussions later today, and I plan to send a summary after each one.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya memiliki dua diskusi tindak lanjut nanti hari ini, dan saya berencana mengirim ringkasan setelah masing-masing selesai.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That is a good habit. Clear summaries usually save time for everyone.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu kebiasaan yang baik. Ringkasan yang jelas biasanya menghemat waktu untuk semua orang.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I agree. It also reduces confusion when people review the discussion later.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya setuju. Itu juga mengurangi kebingungan ketika orang meninjau diskusinya nanti.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: How is the overall workload this week? Is it manageable?
dialogue.indonesian: Bagaimana beban kerja secara keseluruhan minggu ini? Apakah masih bisa ditangani?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: It is busy, but still manageable. I just need to stay organized and avoid too many interruptions.
dialogue.indonesian: Cukup sibuk, tetapi masih bisa ditangani. Saya hanya perlu tetap terorganisir dan menghindari terlalu banyak gangguan.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That makes sense. Please make sure you leave enough time for follow-up work after meetings.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu masuk akal. Tolong pastikan kamu menyisakan cukup waktu untuk pekerjaan tindak lanjut setelah rapat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Yes, I already blocked some time this afternoon for that.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, saya sudah memblokir beberapa waktu sore ini untuk itu.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Good planning. Are there any risks you want me to be aware of right now?
dialogue.indonesian: Perencanaan yang bagus. Apakah ada risiko yang perlu saya ketahui sekarang?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: The main risk is still the technical issue on my side. If my laptop freezes again, I may need to reconnect.
dialogue.indonesian: Risiko utamanya masih masalah teknis di sisi saya. Jika laptop saya freeze lagi, saya mungkin perlu menyambung ulang.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Understood. If that happens, send me a quick message so I know what is going on.
dialogue.indonesian: Dipahami. Jika itu terjadi, kirim saya pesan singkat agar saya tahu apa yang sedang terjadi.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I will do that. I do not want the delay to create confusion.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya akan melakukannya. Saya tidak ingin keterlambatan itu menimbulkan kebingungan.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That is appreciated. Aside from the technical issues, I think your progress looks solid.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya menghargainya. Selain masalah teknis, saya rasa progres kamu terlihat solid.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Thank you. I am trying to keep everything on track despite the interruptions.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Saya berusaha menjaga semuanya tetap sesuai rencana meskipun ada gangguan.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That effort is visible. Please continue to communicate early if something starts slipping.
dialogue.indonesian: Usaha itu terlihat. Tolong terus komunikasikan lebih awal jika ada sesuatu yang mulai meleset.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Absolutely. I prefer to raise concerns early rather than wait until the last minute.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu. Saya lebih memilih menyampaikan kendala lebih awal daripada menunggu sampai menit terakhir.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Excellent. Before we wrap up, let us confirm the next steps.
dialogue.indonesian: Sangat baik. Sebelum kita akhiri, mari kita konfirmasi langkah selanjutnya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Sure. I will complete the open items, send a summary, and keep you updated if my system causes any delays.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu. Saya akan menyelesaikan hal-hal yang masih terbuka, mengirim ringkasan, dan memberi Anda pembaruan jika sistem saya menyebabkan keterlambatan.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: That covers the essentials. Please also check whether your laptop needs support from the office team.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu sudah mencakup hal-hal penting. Tolong juga cek apakah laptop kamu membutuhkan bantuan dari tim kantor.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Yes, I was thinking about that. If the freezing continues, I will report it today.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, saya juga memikirkan itu. Jika masalah freeze berlanjut, saya akan melaporkannya hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: Good idea. It is better to solve it now than let it affect more meetings later.
dialogue.indonesian: Ide yang bagus. Lebih baik diselesaikan sekarang daripada mengganggu lebih banyak rapat nanti.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I agree. It has already made this meeting more difficult than it needed to be.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya setuju. Masalah itu sudah membuat rapat ini lebih sulit dari yang seharusnya.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: No problem. These things happen, especially with online meetings.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak masalah. Hal seperti ini memang terjadi, terutama dalam rapat online.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Thank you for being understanding. That helps a lot.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah pengertian. Itu sangat membantu.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: You are welcome. Overall, I am satisfied with the update and your plan for the rest of the day.
dialogue.indonesian: Sama-sama. Secara keseluruhan, saya puas dengan pembaruan dan rencana kamu untuk sisa hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I am glad to hear that. I will stay focused on the remaining tasks.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya senang mendengarnya. Saya akan tetap fokus pada tugas-tugas yang tersisa.

dialogue.speaker: Boss
dialogue.english: All right then. Thank you for your time today, and please send me the summary once you are done.
dialogue.indonesian: Baiklah. Terima kasih atas waktunya hari ini, dan tolong kirimkan ringkasannya kepada saya setelah selesai.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Certainly. Thank you for the meeting and for your patience with the technical issues. I will send the summary later today.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu. Terima kasih atas rapatnya dan atas kesabaran Anda terhadap masalah teknis tadi. Saya akan mengirim ringkasannya nanti hari ini.
